Instagram profile
Facebook page and Facebook Marketplace
Amazon seller / storefront
Other marketplaces (JustDial, IndiaMART, Zomato, Swiggy, Flipkart, Meesho)
Google Business Profile and Google search
Reddit
Their own website (if they have one)

assignments.name: website_prompt
assignments.value:
Review this small business website: {website}
Open it (and up to 2 inner pages). Score it 1-10 for overall quality and SEO:
mobile-friendly design, clear services, contact details and call-to-action, page titles / meta descriptions / headings,
trust signals (reviews, photos), speed, and how up to date it looks.
10 = excellent, nothing to improve. If it does not load, or is only a social media / listing page, score 1.

Reply with only: <json>{"website_score": <1-10>, "notes": "<one sentence>"}</json>

assignments.name: enrich_prompt
assignments.value:
Research this small business in India and collect public information about it.

Business:
{business}

Look in these places (web search, then open the most useful pages):
{sources}

Rules:
- Search by phone number as well as name + area. Only use pages that clearly match this business.
- Only report facts you actually found. Never guess or make up an email address.
- Use null (or []) for anything you could not find. Do not log in anywhere.

Reply with only this JSON inside <json></json> tags:
<json>{
 "confirmed": true or false,
 "phone": "", "email": "", "instagram_url": "", "facebook_url": "",
 "other_profiles": ["marketplace or listing urls"],
 "rating": number or null, "review_count": number or null,
 "top_reviews": ["short quote, max 3"],
 "services": ["what they sell or offer"], "about": "2-3 sentences",
 "photo_urls": ["direct image urls, max 4"],
 "headline": "short website headline", "tagline": "one line"
}</json>

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads SET
  status = $2, website_score = $3::int, website_notes = $4,
  enrichment_score = $5::int, enrichment = $6::jsonb, landing_html = $7,
  email = COALESCE(NULLIF($8, ''), email), notes = $9, processed_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int
RETURNING id, name, status, website_score, enrichment_score;
